question: Are all rites here prescribed, or all prohibited — and what of breath-yogas?
premises: everything here is both prescribed and even prohibited
yogas with breath-restraint limbs would be artificial
inference: blanket prescription and prohibition both miss; constructed yogas are artificial.
uncertainties: krttrima (artificial/made) pivot to v108 akrtaka kept explicit
plain_english: All indeed is here prescribed, and even prohibited — yogas with prāṇāyāma and other limbs would be artificial, because.
